verdict.rationale: Stripe documents isolated sandboxes for testing Stripe functionality without affecting live mode, where simulated transactions with test values move no funds. Sandboxes can be provisioned instantly via the CLI or used through Workbench Shell for full API writes. Test cards simulate successful payments plus declines, fraud and invalid-data errors. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of test cards or flows that trigger disputes, explicit confirmation that the sandbox mirrors production behavior end to end, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing experience.
